section_summary.extract_value: This section presents descriptive statistics and correlation analyses results for a study with nonclinical female samples. The text reports that BMI showed negative correlations with social safeness and body appreciation (BAS-2), with the latter being a moderate negative correlation. Multiple other correlations among variables (social safeness, flexible eating, and eating disorder symptoms) are also described.
